verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs describe it as a drop-in OpenAI replacement. You point the OpenAI SDK at its base URL, swap the API key and model name, and 'your code works without changes.' Conversations are sent as the full message history on every request, so an agent can move a workflow to or from DeepInfra without provider-specific code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of compatibility fidelity, and explicit documentation of mid-workflow switching (the model name must still change per provider).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Drop-in OpenAI replacement. Point your existing OpenAI SDK to https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai and your code works without changes.
OpenAI-compatible chat completions API — just change the base URL and model name.
To create a longer conversation, include the full message history in every request.
